 Sean Pedulla To Sign Two-Way Contract With Kings
 By Rory Maher |
 at October 23, 2026 3:54 pm 
 Free agent guard Sean Pedulla has agreed to a two-way contract with the Kings , agent George S. Langberg tells Shams Charania of ESPN ( Twitter link ).
 Pedulla joined the Rip City Remix last fall after going undrafted out of Ole Miss. After spending most of his rookie year with the Trail Blazers’ G League affiliate, he signed a two-year, two-way contract with the Clippers after the All-Star break in February and finished the season with L.A. However, he was waived by the Clippers in August , which made him an unrestricted free agent.
 Pedulla made seven NBA regular season appearances for L.A. but spent most of the 2025/26 campaign in the G League, appearing in 42 total games for the Remix and the San Diego Clippers. The 6’1″ point guard averaged 20.3 points, 5.5 assists, 4.1 rebounds, and 1.5 steals in 28.1 minutes per contest, earning NBAGL Rookie of the Year honors.
 The 24-year-old signed a two-year, two-way deal with Houston 10 days after he was cut by the Clippers. But after spending training camp and the preseason with the Rockets, he was waived four days ago, just before this season began.
 Sacramento, one of only three NBA teams with an open two-way spot , was said to be eyeing backcourt help in the wake of Ben Simmons ’ torn Achilles tendon. Pedulla was first linked to the Kings by Jake Fischer of Bleacher Report and The Stein Line.
